pages.text: Yara and Fizz go down a long path in the wood.
pages.picture: girl and dragon walking down a forest path

pages.text: The trees get thick. The path gets wet. Then it ends at a big, deep bog.
pages.picture: the path ending at a dark wide bog

pages.text: Mud! Muck! Fog! It smells bad. "Yuck!" said Fizz.
pages.picture: dragon holding his nose in the fog

pages.text: Then the mud starts to churn. Blob, blob, blob!
Up pops a monster with six arms and a big, wet chin. "I am Grub!" he shouts.
pages.picture: a funny six-armed mud monster rising out of the bog

pages.text: "This is my bog. No one gets past me!"
pages.picture: the mud monster blocking the way with all six arms

pages.text: Fizz huffs a big huff. But he is too little. No sparks shoot out.
pages.picture: baby dragon huffing but no fire comes out

pages.text: Grub grins. Fizz looks down at his feet.
Yara thinks and thinks. Then she has a plan.
